response.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(GOT) as overall_got FROM Laboratory WHERE GOT IS NOT NULL) SELECT l.ID, AVG(l.GOT) as avg_got, AVG(l.RBC) as avg_rbc, AVG(l.GOT) - oa.overall_got as difference FROM Laboratory l, overall_avg oa GROUP BY l.ID, oa.overall_got HAVING oa.overall_got IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN AVG(l.GOT) - oa.overall_got IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, AVG(l.GOT) - oa.overall_got DESC LIMIT 10
